changelog:
Initial release: Complete, structured ML & AI engineering methodology for experiment-to-production workflows.

- Provides a phased ML system design: problem framing, data engineering, experiment management, and more.
- Includes YAML/spec templates for problem briefs, experiment tracking, and feature store design.
- Offers checklists and practical guides for data quality scoring, leakage prevention, feature engineering, and model selection.
- Features side-by-side ML vs rule-based decision criteria and kill criteria for ML efforts.
- Curates algorithm recommendations and hyperparameter tuning strategies for major ML tasks.
summary: Provides end-to-end methodology for defining, engineering, experimenting, deploying, and operating production ML/AI systems at scale.
